definitions.explanation: Cables used to transmit electrical power over long distances.

examples.japanese: ⟦{架空|かくう}→架空：00152_kakuu⟧{送電線|そうでんせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{点検|てんけん}→点検：09765_tenken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: To conduct an inspection of overhead power lines.

examples.japanese: {送電線|そうでんせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れた→切れる：01085_kireru⟧。
⟦{高圧|こうあつ}→高圧：02738_kouatsu⟧{送電線|そうでんせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{近|ちか}づかないで→近づく：01904_chikazuku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't go near the high-voltage power lines.

notes:
{送電線|そうでんせん} refers to power transmission cables.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{架空|かくう}→架空：00152_kakuu⟧{送電線|そうでんせん}: overhead power line
- ⟦{高圧|こうあつ}→高圧：02738_kouatsu⟧{送電線|そうでんせん}: high-voltage power line
- {送電線|そうでんせん}⟦{鉄塔|てっとう}→鉄塔：02622_tettou⟧: transmission tower

RELATED WORDS:
- {電線|でんせん}: electric wire, power line (general term)
- ⟦{配電|はいでん}→配電：00066_haiden⟧: power distribution
- ⟦{送電|そうでん}→送電：04394_souden⟧: power transmission
